libs.note: BH-5269. The CONFLICT HOTSPOTS section of the project primer (bin/verification-map.sh render) and the hotlist bin/plan-gate.sh reads for its Shared-files report. Reads GET /api/conflict-hotspots (the conflict_hotspots rows the weekly conflict-hotspots-fleet lane writes) once per render, only when JOBS_URL is set. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-08-BH-5269-conflict-discipline-prompts.md.

knobs.note: How many hotspot rows reach the primer and the hotlist (the route's limit). 0 = the section reads ABSENT (off) and no request is made. A value that is not a whole number in 0..50 is not clamped: one PLAN_CONTEXT_HOTSPOTS_BADKNOB stderr line and the section is off. Read per project through lib_env_apply plan-context-hotspots <project>; code default 10.
